name: tpl-chain-response-3-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task is not just to reach the exit but to carry the box there, and the candidate only has Existence(at_exit). Missing clauses: Existence(at_exit) needs Response(at_exit, holding_box) so the box is in hand when the exit is reached (Carry the box to the exit), and the sentence If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move requires a hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) (very next step, not a plain Response). Add these hard clauses; keep Existence(at_exit).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) plus Response(at_exit, holding_box) captures 'carry the box to the exit' (reaching the exit while holding the box), and the hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) requires the box to be in hand again on the very next step after a fall, matching 'pick it up again on your very next move'.

texts: Carry the box to the exit.
When reaching the exit, hold the box.
If the box falls, pick it up again on the very next step.
